plan: [Second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values: bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy. Other rational bidders will likely bid their values as well. Ties are random but truthful bidding maximizes expected surplus and cannot be improved upon. Bid exactly your private value $40 to maximize expected profit.]

[In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy. I win whenever my value exceeds the highest competitor value and pay the second-highest bid, so shading or overbidding cannot increase expected payoff. Competitors are rational and likely bid their values too. Therefore I will bid my private value of $13.]

[This is a sealed-bid second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid your value) is a dominant strategy regardless of others’ strategies. My private value is $17, increments of $0.1 allowed. To maximize long-run profit and avoid overpaying, I will bid my true value of 17.0. Ties are resolved randomly; probability negligible.]
